Strategy: Apply the [28,42] sweet-band bonus only when the residual spread is narrow, under 25, and use pure Best Fit when bins are widely spread.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if max(bins) - min(bins) < 25 and 28 <= r - item <= 42 else 0) for r in bins]
```
